Take a look at the Deck Breakdown from the Top 64 of the North America WCQ!

Fiendsmith Snake-Eye Decks are dominating the Top 64, with 29 Duelists currently piloting the Deck. Tenpai Dragon Decks are trailing as the second most represented Deck in the Top 64, which was a recurring theme in the Top Tables Updates earlier in the weekend. 13 Duelists using Tenpai Dragon Decks made it into the Top 64. Fiendsmith Yubel Decks were represented by 9 Duelists in the Top 64. The numbers drop down significantly from there. Runick, Ritual Beast, and Horus Gimmick Puppet Decks are each represented by 2 Duelists in the Top 64, while the remaining Decks each have only 1 Duelist piloting them. Any one of these Decks can still take the championship win, so follow the coverage to see how it all unfolds!

Here’s the complete breakdown of all Decks in the 2024 North America WCQ!

From a total of 2635 Duelists, we can see a huge number of Fiendsmith Snake-Eyes! With 669 total Decks, it makes up 25% of the Decks in total. Tenpai Dragons are next with just under 400 Duelists, for 15% of the field. Close behind are Fiendsmith Yubel Decks, with 266 Duelists for a 10% share of the tournament.

There’s a lot of variety in the other rogue strategies, with Despia Branded, Ritual Beast, and Voiceless Voice all having similar numbers. Pure Snake-Eye Decks are still popular, as well as Kashtira. Somehow, there are exactly 55 Decks for each of Spright, Labrynth, and Runick.

Of course, none of these Decks, not even Fiendsmith Snake-Eye, can match the popularity of the Other category! Nearly 800 Duelists, or 30% of Duelists are using something so unique that it wouldn’t show up on our graph. Even at an event like the NAWCQ, Duelists are going to try their luck with their favorite Decks! Looking at the Top 64 with Decks like Gimmick Puppets, Tearlaments, and Mementotlan, there’s proof that those “Other” Decks can hang with the best!
